English Proficiency
United States Citizens or Permanent Residents
Regardless of citizenship, applicants may be required to demonstrate proof of English language proficiency if they do not have a degree from an institution where the primary language of instruction is English.
International
Students
Proof of English language proficiency is required in cases where there are official languages other than, or in addition to, English.
English Proficiency Test Scores
U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, and International Students may submit English proficiency scores directly to the Office of Graduate Admissions at Colorado State University, 1062 Campus Delivery, Fort Collins, CO 80523-1062.
Scores on the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), International English Language Testing System (IELTS), Duolingo or Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic should be submitted to Colorado State University, Fort Collins Graduate. Photocopies will not be accepted.
When the CSU graduate degree program is taught in the student’s native language, the TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, or the PTE Academic requirement will be waived.
Students are exempted from the TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, or PTE Academic requirement if the official language of their country is solely English, or if they have recently earned a degree at a university in the United States, or if they have recently earned a degree from a university in a country on the English Language Proficiency Exempt List maintained by the Graduate School as published below.

**English Speaking West Indies
English language proficiency testing is not required for applicants who have U.S. citizenship or nationality and are residents of an official U.S. territory or are citizens of Freely Associated States of the U.S. including:
American Samoa
Guam
Northern Mariana Islands
Puerto Rico
U.S. Virgin Islands
Micronesia
Republic of the Marshall Islands
Palau
Minimum Test Scores
CSU requires that proficiency in the English language be demonstrated either by the TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, or and PTE Academic tests prior to admission. Official scores, taken within two years prior to admission, must be submitted directly from the testing agency.
English Test
Clear Admission Minimum
TOEFL IBT* (Before January 2026)
80
TOEFL IBT* (After January 2026)
4.5
TOEFL PBT (Paper-Based)
550
IELTS Academic (including the IELTS OneSkills Retake)
6.5
Duolingo
120
PTE
58
Note: Your department may have higher TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo/PTE score requirements.
CSU Graduate Admissions does NOT accept test scores from:
General IELTS
IELTS indicator
iTEP
TOEFL ITP
TOEFL Essentials
